_help.styles.draft: How a glyphling looks while you drag it out of the tray to place it (the draft). A · Pick it up: the piece leaves its spot, rides under your finger and settles where you drop it. B · Lift, mark home: the same, but a faint ghost stays at home. C · Aim: the piece stays home and a see-through copy follows you; on a good drop the real piece flies from home to the hex. D · Float: a see-through copy follows you, home is empty, and it turns solid where you drop it. A wrong drop flies back home (A, B, D) or fades away (C).
_help.styles.seed: How a seed looks while you drag it from the tray onto the board to aim it. A · Pick it up · B · Lift, mark home · C · Aim · D · Float — see the draft setting above for what each one does.
_help.styles.reorder: How a seed looks while you drag it to another place in the tray (it switches to this style once it's over another place, and uses it all the time while choosing seeds to refresh). A · Pick it up · B · Lift, mark home · C · Aim · D · Float — see the draft setting above.
_help.styles.move: How a glyphling on the board looks while you drag it to move it. A · Pick it up · B · Lift, mark home · C · Aim (the real glyphling then glides there, like a tapped move) · D · Float — see the draft setting above.
_help.ghostOpacity: How see-through a ghost is — the copy that follows you (C, D) and the mark left at home (B). Lower = fainter. Try 0.3–0.6.
_help.liftScale: A carried piece is drawn this much bigger, so it reads as "in your hand". 1 = no bigger. Try 1.05–1.2.
_help.liftShadow: How strong the shadow under a carried piece is. 0 = no shadow. Try 0.2–0.5.
_help.liftTime: How long a piece takes to grow into your hand when a drag starts, in seconds. Try 0.05–0.15.
_help.landTime: How long a dropped piece takes to settle onto its spot (A, B) or turn solid there (D), in seconds. The game changes once it has landed. Try 0.1–0.2.
_help.flyTime: How long the real piece takes to fly from home to the spot (C), or a wrongly dropped piece to fly back home (A, B, D), in seconds. Try 0.15–0.3.
_help.fadeTime: How long a wrongly dropped piece takes to fade away (C), in seconds. Try 0.1–0.25.
_help.targets.draft: What shows at the board while you drag a glyphling out of the tray (the draft). Highlight: the legal hex under the piece lights up. Ghost preview: a see-through copy of the piece sits on that hex (and the hex glows fainter). Aim line: a line with an arrow runs from the piece's home to your pointer (and the hex still lights up).
_help.targets.seed: What shows at the board while you drag a seed onto it. Highlight · Ghost preview · Aim line — see the draft setting above.
_help.targets.move: What shows at the board while you drag a glyphling on it. Highlight · Ghost preview · Aim line — see the draft setting above.
_help.targets.reorder: What the tray shows while you drag a seed onto another seed in it. None: nothing extra. Insertion marker: a slim bar in your colour where the seed will slide in. Make room: the seeds on each side of that spot slide apart. Over an empty place neither shows — the seed just moves into it.
_help.snap: How strongly a legal hex pulls the dragged piece once it's near — and letting go there lands on that hex. 0 = no pull. Try 0.3–0.7.
_help.snapRadius: How near the piece must be for a legal hex to pull it, as a share of a piece's size. Try 0.4–0.8.
_help.makeRoom: Make room: how far the tray's seeds slide apart, as a share of a seed's place. Try 0.2–0.5.
_help.roomTime: Make room: how long the tray's seeds take to slide apart (and back), in seconds. Try 0.1–0.2.
_help.tetherBend: Aim line: how much it curves. 0 = straight. Try 0–0.25.
_help.arrowSize: Aim line: its arrow head, in pixels. 0 = no head. Try 8–16.
_help.ghostGlow: With Ghost preview, how strongly the hex under it still glows (1 = as bright as Highlight, 0 = no glow). Try 0.3–0.6.
